text:
lia: FYI EdgeScale raised a reconciliation alert: negative deltas in marketplace usage after their sku rotation + a timezone cutover over the weekend. They put a sample in the ticket. Can partnerships + metering triage?

tom: on it. link to ticket?

lia: https://acme.ops/tickets/ES-7744 and attached CSV excerpt:```
datetime_utc,sku_id,our_count,partner_count
2026-03-28T01:00:00Z,edge-small,240,240
2026-03-28T02:00:00Z,edge-small,200,0
2026-03-28T03:00:00Z,edge-small,0,180
```

karen: looks like a SKU ID flip around 02:00Z and their ingestion switched to a new sku_id without backfilling. Also they had a TZ config change from PST to UTC on hosts during the maintenance window which might have caused double-apply/zero windows.

zhang: if partner rotated SKUs at 02:00 but the marketplace entitlement mapping still points old_sku->planA until end-of-day, we'll see gaps + negative deltas in rollups. Do we have entitlement history for that partner for the window?

lia: I checked. Our entitlement service has a change_log but the partner's mapping change wasn't submitted via the marketplace webhook. We have the old mapping active for the whole day.

ops-bot: Alert: entitlement-mapping-mismatch detected for partner=edge-scale window=2026-03-28 severity=medium id=ES-7744

tom: immediate mitigation options: 1) treat partner_count as canonical and backfill credits for missing our_count windows, 2) request partner to replay events with original sku_id OR send signed explain payload for rotation, 3) create temporary mapping alias old_sku->new_sku for billing rollups (fastest). Risks: aliasing can mask root cause and affect downstream usage normalization.

karen: I prefer replay or signed explain payload. If they can replay ingest for 02:00-04:00 UTC we can canonicalize and avoid synthetic credits. But partner may not have replay tooling easy to run.

lia: partner says replay is possible but they need our S3 staging path and a short retention NDA note. Also they want an explicit acceptance that we won't expose raw payloads to other teams.

legal: we can sign a redacted-addendum (std template) within 4hrs if engineering provides exact retention path and ACLs. Ping me with the path.

billing-bot: Billing anomaly flagged: partner=edge-scale id=ES-7744 negative-delta-impact=~$1,200 window=2026-03-28 status=open

zhang: ops checklist for replay path:```
- create s3 staging prefix: s3://partners-staging/edge-scale/replay/1819999999/
- provide presigned upload URL + minimal ACLs
- ingestion job (staging->recon) will run in sandbox account
- run reconciliation: recon-tool --window=2026-03-28T00:00Z/2026-03-28T06:00Z --use-partner
```

tom: I'll stand up the ingestion sandbox and run recon once we have the files. karen can review the alias approach if partner can't replay.

lia: touching base with EdgeScale engineer now. If they can't replay, we may do partial alias backfill limited to affected windows only and then run a one-off ledger correction. We should record the correction as non-recurring adjustment.

edge-engineer (via lia): "we can push replay artifacts. we rotate skus via rolling deploy and our exporter used the new sku label without emitting a rotation event this time. sorry for the ops gap."

lia: upload ETA ~45m once legal signoff for staging path + we provide presigned URLs.

legal: sharing redacted-addendum template to lia. please attach exact s3 prefix and retention TTL (we recommend 7 days).

zhang: once files land, I'll run side-by-side: our_rollup vs partner_replay_rollup and generate a reconciliation report with per-sku adjustments. We'll include a reconciliation CSV with signed hashes for audit.

lia: thanks. I'll update ticket ES-7744 and keep thread posted.

tom: tentative timeline: staging + legal signoff 1hr, partner upload 45m, recon + report 45m -> preliminary before EOD.

lia: noted. tagging billing for potential credits path. billing-bot: please hold any auto-invoice adjustments until we complete recon.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. auto-adjusts paused for id=ES-7744 until manual-clear.

karen: small ask: record the exact rotation commit hash from partner if they have it so we can correlate exporter version. That often surfaces root cause.

edge-engineer (via lia): "commit sha: a1b2c3d rotate/exporter v2.4.5. we'll include with replay bundle."

lia: closing loop here. next updates once upload completes. :white_check_mark:
